description: This file defines the SparkUI class, which is the top-level user interface component for a Spark application. It manages HTTP handlers, tabs, application info, and server lifecycle for the Spark web UI.

classes.name: SparkUI
classes.description: Top-level class managing the Spark application's web UI, including server handlers, tabs, application info, and lifecycle.

classes.name: SparkUITab
classes.description: Abstract class representing a tab in the Spark UI, providing access to parent SparkUI's properties.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a SparkUI with given parameters.

methods.name: attachAllHandlers
methods.description: Attaches all existing handlers to the server info.

methods.name: attachHandler
methods.description: Attaches a new handler to the UI, pending readiness.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes all UI components and handlers.

methods.name: getSparkUser
methods.description: Retrieves the Spark user name from application info or system properties.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Starts the Jetty server and binds to the address.

methods.name: withSparkUI
methods.description: Executes a function with the current SparkUI if appId matches.

methods.name: checkUIViewPermissions
methods.description: Checks if a user has permission to view the UI.

methods.name: getApplicationInfoList
methods.description: Returns an iterator of application info objects.

methods.name: getApplicationInfoList (overloaded)
methods.description: Returns filtered application info objects, limited by max.

methods.name: getStreamingJobProgressListener
methods.description: Returns the current streaming job progress listener.

methods.name: setStreamingJobProgressListener
methods.description: Sets the streaming job progress listener.

methods.name: clearStreamingJobProgressListener
methods.description: Clears the streaming job progress listener.
